usage: 雞蛋 (gai1 daan2) is a noun used to refer to eggs, typically from chickens.
You can use 雞蛋 as the subject or object in a sentence, like when talking about buying or cooking eggs.
The word can be combined with other words to describe different uses, for example, 煎雞蛋 means fried egg.
雞蛋 is countable, so you can say 一隻雞蛋 (one egg) or two instead of just using the noun alone.
It's common to use 雞蛋 in daily conversation related to food and cooking.
